config.title: 晴光与泡影
config.subtitle: 把期待写成晴光，让灵感泛起涟漪。
config.memory: 晴光落在身旁，泡影轻轻回响。

layers.motionTipSelection: maximum weighted opaque source pixel with both braid junctions fixed

night.coordinateSystem: SVG paths, bounds, pivots and radius are in decoded 1272x847 source pixels. Eyes use normalized centers and radii; angles are radians. Rotation is degrees; period is seconds; phase is radians.
night.ownership: Each moving path is removed from the fixed original and appears exactly once in its moving source layer. Generated underfill is only behind the resulting holes. Preserve original source RGB; do not warp the entire illustration.

layers.underfill: Continue orange hair at the upper cut seam, wooden bench behind the lower free end. Purple bow and upper braid stay fixed.
Continue pink hair at the left root; continue dark blue station floor/reflection behind the free upper contour. Main ponytail, ribbon, torso and every column remain fixed.

Continue purple/white cloak at the upper diagonal cut seam, wood beneath the free lower hem. Keep gold cord, round tie and left tassel around x304,y743 fixed. No skin, hand, thigh or bench pixels belong to this path. The left fastening edge at x307,y743–758 remains pinned beside the fixed gold cord.
Continue the dangling purple ribbon at its top seam and original dark floor behind it. The nearby hem, bench plank edge and bench shadow remain stationary.

The long solid pink lock falls in front of the blue celestial train. Extend original unowned boundary pixels inward at most 40px, so its inner edge reveals blue train and its outer edge reveals floor; never reveal a floor-only cleanplate against the blue train. The fixed upper hair root is tapered over 25px.

Only the freely hanging pink-brown sleeve cuff with gold edge. Keep shoulder, braid/cord fastening, upper arm, glove, body and legs fixed. Extend adjacent fixed garment pixels into the ownership hole for the revealed strip; fallback cleanplate only deeper than 40px.

Two connected orange braid lobes and their clasp bend between fixed upper cape contact and the fixed purple bow. Only original hair/clasp pixels belong to this path. Keep cloak, shoulder, skin, hands and bench fixed; nearest unowned floor/garment extends at most40px into the ownership hole.

night.reviewLimitations: Conservative hand-traced contours. Fine antialias pixels are approximated. Inspect the mask overlay and maximal motion frames before enabling; any mask taking visible wood, floor or skin pixels must be tightened or disabled. No head/torso translation or whole-canvas UV sway is permitted.
night.motionModel: Bounded shared FM breeze with root/mid/tip analytical responses. Only detail layers have spatial delay; old large pieces keep a scalar response and the exact existing geometric amplitude envelope. Positive delayed returns are a visual approximation, not an integrated spring or full Live2D rig.

scenes.label: 果园午后
scenes.description: 苹果、阳光，还有陪在身边的人。

scenes.label: 夜色相依
scenes.description: 肩头相依，把温柔留在身旁。

scenes.label: 夜色相依·泪光
scenes.description: 西西悄悄落泪，娅娅仍守在身旁。

scenes.label: 并肩晴空
scenes.description: 让两个人站进同一片金色晴空。

scenes.label: 昭日遇见暗潮
scenes.description: 递出一束暖光，等一个轻轻的回应。

scenes.label: 靠近的瞬间
scenes.description: 有些故事，靠近一点就懂了。

scenes.label: 镜片里的晚霞
scenes.description: 把普通的一天也变成合照。

scenes.label: 晴日慢车
scenes.description: 风经过的地方，也想带你去。

scenes.label: 抱进梦里
scenes.description: 晚安，把一点牵挂留在枕边。

scenes.label: 风与发梢
scenes.description: 微风翻过发梢，灵感也轻轻抵达。

scenes.label: 薄荷白日梦
scenes.description: 托着下巴，等你说说今天。

scenes.label: 泡影击掌
scenes.description: 来自另一边的可爱回应。
